title: Microchip pet door fitted to a pool-barrier gate (Blenheim)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
code_edition: NZ Building Code F9 with F9/AS1 and NZS 8500:2006 as cited
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Owner disputed the compliance of a microchip-operated pet door fitted to the east-side gate of the pool area; the authority is Marlborough District Council.

Appendix A quotes F9/AS1 (barriers: no climbable rails, no 100 mm sphere openings, barriers not angled more than 15 degrees) and NZS 8500:2006 child-resistant doorset requirements (self-latching, automatic return).
Discussion (§5) considers the device against F9/AS1 and NZS 8500.
Decision: pool barrier with the microchip pet door installed in the east gate does not comply with F9 (24 May 2022).
